description: MdnSendResult and MdnParseResult define their fields using fully-qualified paths: std::collections::HashMap<jmap_types::Id, ...> instead of importing the types. Standard Rust style uses 'use' declarations at the top of the module and short names in struct bodies. The full-path style reads like C++ and makes the struct definitions harder to scan. Note: JMAP-bkqp tracks the same issue at P3 (opinion) — upgrading to P2 here because it is objectively non-idiomatic in public API types, not merely a style preference. Fix: add 'use jmap_types::Id; use jmap_mail_types::mdn::Mdn; use jmap_server::backend::SetError;' to mdn.rs and use short names in the struct definitions.
title: MdnSendResult/MdnParseResult use full paths in struct fields (non-idiomatic)
